# archestra_skill (Resource)

A versioned skill with declarative manifest metadata, instruction body and complete resource files. Import by UUID. Updates reject stale versions. Destroy soft-deletes the skill; immutable historical versions remain under platform retention. Configure sharing through permissions on this skill. Git-synchronized content remains owned by its external source and the API rejects conflicting edits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_skill" "procedure" {
  name        = "repository-procedure"
  description = "Instructions for repository maintenance"
  content     = "Inspect the repository instructions before making changes."
  files = {
    "references/checklist.md" = {
      content  = "Run the relevant checks and report their results."
      encoding = "utf8"
    }
  }
  environment_ids = []
  labels          = []
}

# Files, environment restrictions and labels are authoritative collections.
# Updates use the last observed immutable version; a conflict requires a new plan.
# Destroy soft-deletes the skill instead of permanently purging its history.

# Use the same resource for repository-owned content. This pinned public fixture
# contains a harmless synthetic Skill; replace its URL/path with your source.
resource "archestra_skill" "git_procedure" {
  git_source = {
    repo_url      = "https://github.com/archestra-ai/terraform-provider-archestra/tree/411935fb1648ca812dff1f3503c0be77db65bcf3"
    skill_path    = "scripts/integration/fixtures/skills/synthetic"
    sync_interval = "1d"
  }
  environment_ids = []
  labels          = []
  permissions     = []
}

# Git owns name, description, instructions, manifest options and files. Omit those
# inputs in Git mode. Icon, labels, environment restrictions and sharing remain
# editable. Switching between authored and Git content replaces the Skill.
```

## Schema

### Required

- `environment_ids` (Set of String) Complete environment restrictions; an empty set allows every environment.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Complete set of resource labels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))

### Optional

- `agent_name` (String) Agent name used when activating this skill delegates execution.
- `allowed_tools` (Set of String) Tools pre-approved by the skill manifest.
- `compatibility` (String) Manifest compatibility information.
- `content` (String) Markdown instruction body without frontmatter.
- `description` (String) Skill description rendered into manifest frontmatter.
- `files` (Attributes Map) Complete resource files keyed by relative path; an empty map clears files. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `git_source` (Attributes) GitHub or GitLab source for one Skill. Configure this instead of manifest fields and files. Scheduled pulls own content; icon, environments, labels and permissions remain editable here. Changing between authored and Git content replaces the Skill. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git_source))
- `icon` (String) Display emoji or image data URL.
- `license` (String) Manifest license.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Manifest metadata entries.
- `name` (String) Skill name rendered into manifest frontmatter.
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Additional direct sharing grants. Authored Skills apply these atomically on creation. Git Skills are imported privately, then environment/settings updates and sharing are applied. Omit to preserve grants; [] clears additional grants while preserving the owner's access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `templated` (Boolean) Whether the instruction body uses Handlebars rendering.

### Read-Only

- `author_id` (String) Author id reported by the API.
- `created_at` (String) Created at reported by the API.
- `created_by` (String) Creator identity metadata as JSON.
- `created_by_service_account_id` (String) Created by service account id reported by the API.
- `deleted_at` (String) Deleted at reported by the API.
- `digest` (String) Digest reported by the API.
- `file_digests` (Map of String) Backend content digests keyed by resource file path.
- `github_app_config_id` (String) Github app config id reported by the API.
- `github_pat_id` (String) Github pat id reported by the API.
- `github_sync_interval` (String) Github sync interval reported by the API.
- `github_sync_ref` (String) Github sync ref reported by the API.
- `gitlab_token_id` (String) Gitlab token id reported by the API.
- `id` (String) Skill UUID.
- `last_sync_error` (String) Last sync error reported by the API.
- `last_synced_at` (String) Last synced at reported by the API.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last used at reported by the API.
- `latest_version` (Number) Latest immutable content version used for optimistic updates.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization id reported by the API.
- `scope` (String) Scope reported by the API.
- `source_commit` (String) Source commit reported by the API.
- `source_origin` (String) Source origin reported by the API.
- `source_provider` (String) Source provider reported by the API.
- `source_ref` (String) Source ref reported by the API.
- `source_type` (String) Source type reported by the API.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at reported by the API.
- `usage_count` (Number) Recorded activation count.

<a id="nestedatt--labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `labels`

Required:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Required:

- `content` (String) Resource file content in the specified encoding.
- `encoding` (String) Resource file content encoding.


<a id="nestedatt--git_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git_source`

Required:

- `repo_url` (String) Repository path or URL, optionally with /tree/<ref>. Select one repository-root-relative folder using skill_path. Use an immutable commit in the URL when content must stay pinned.
- `skill_path` (String) Safe relative directory containing SKILL.md, measured from the repository root; use an empty string for the root.

Optional:

- `github_app_id` (String) Saved Git credential UUID; omit for a public repository. Only one credential may be selected. GitLab references use Credential.definition_id.
- `github_pat_id` (String) Saved Git credential UUID; omit for a public repository. Only one credential may be selected. GitLab references use Credential.definition_id.
- `gitlab_token_id` (String) Saved Git credential UUID; omit for a public repository. Only one credential may be selected. GitLab references use Credential.definition_id.
- `provider` (String) Git provider, matching the selected stored credential.
- `sync_interval` (String) Scheduled pull interval. Git content stays read-only in Archestra while connected.


<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `actions` (Set of String) Actions granted to the principal.
- `subject_id` (String) Principal ID; use * for the organization principal.
- `subject_type` (String) Principal type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by skill UUID.
terraform import archestra_skill.procedure 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
